strip.title: Workshop Status
strip.sub: Vehicles in the workshop report today. Select a figure to open it.
strip.errorAll: Workshop Status figures could not be loaded. They read N/A until a retry succeeds.
strip.errorPartial: Some Workshop Status figures could not be loaded. Those read N/A.
strip.capped: Capped view. The workshop list is larger than the display limit; pick a country for exact counts.
strip.empty: No vehicles are in the workshop report and no daily file has been uploaded yet.
strip.activeHint: Vehicles currently listed in the daily workshop report.
strip.waiting7Hint: Active vehicles out of operation for more than 7 days.
strip.overdueHint: Active vehicles whose expected release date has already passed.
strip.releasedTodayHint: Vehicles that left the daily workshop report today.
strip.lastUploadHint: The most recent confirmed daily workshop Excel file.
